Resolves #20347

Related: #20328

Main units and both timezone probes now share one prepared `unit` job. The main suite keeps its four CI workers, followed by separate +14 and −11 processes; each retains its own log, JSON report and failure artifacts. Any failed or killed invocation makes the aggregate fail while the remaining selected processes still run. This replaces three runner allocations and three preparations with one, preserving dispatch selection, scope classification and the current-head guard.

Evidence: L3 hosted execution on `8d299f86fb852f79260cd528a370d1f09854e702`, plus controlled local failure/cancellation cases. Broader org queue improvement remains owned by #20328.

## Hosted Comparison

The candidate's [single unit job](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/42079253149/job/127427890071) passed. Its [workflow run](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/42079253149) has one unit job, three unchanged component jobs and the classifier. Compare the ticket's [three-job baseline](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/42048502578):

| Measurement | Baseline | Candidate |
|---|---:|---:|
| Unit-family runner allocations | 3 | 1 |
| Test-step time | 146s + 3s + 4s | 152s combined |
| Sum of unit-family job wall times | 177s + 33s + 33s = 243s | 187s |
| Main population | 5,752 passed / 116 skipped | 5,869 passed / 118 skipped |
| Timezone populations | 19 + 19 passed | 19 + 19 passed |

The candidate queued for 53s before starting. These are individual observations on different dev revisions, not a controlled speedup or org-wide queue claim. Suite definitions, worker counts, skip policy, retries and timeouts are unchanged; intervening commits account for the expanded main population. The candidate saved two allocations and 56 summed runner-seconds in this sample.

## AC Evidence

| Criterion | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `UnitCiWorkflow.spec.mjs` verifies one non-matrix `unit` job and all three invocations; the hosted comparison above records the actual allocation and populations. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the same spec checks distinct logs, reports and artifact directories, separate timezone processes, and absence of global reporter overrides. The real local sequence retained all three reports. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: failures injected into each position, missing/invalid reports, and a SIGTERM after report creation all fail the aggregate; remaining selected invocations execute. GitHub cancellation is not converted into success. |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: actual job condition evaluated across PR/push/dispatch, classifier true/false and all dispatch suites; current/stale head execution, selection, repetition and option-token refusal. Existing `WorkflowScopeClassifier.spec.mjs` owns classifier path/full-run coverage. |
| AC-5 | Hosted comparison above records one unit job, 152s test step, 187s total job time and all three populations against the linked baseline. No retry or timeout policy changes. |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive. The existing current-head script is shared with the unchanged component jobs through a YAML anchor. Fixed-path JSON is snapshotted between invocations because overriding Playwright's reporter environment also affects nested CLI tests. No new production module is introduced.

## Test Evidence

Executed the workflow's actual `Run unit family` Bash locally with `CI=true` and normal selection: 65.925s total; main reported 5,833 expected, 117 skipped and one flaky test, followed by 19 passing +14 and 19 passing −11 tests. Exit statuses were `main=1`, `plus14=0`, `minus11=0`, preserving the failure and both later reports. This is local execution evidence, not a hosted speedup measurement.

The local main failure is an existing Docs fixture leak from `HierarchyTreeList.spec.mjs`: its `Neo.main.addon.HighlightJS` stub survives teardown and collides with the real addon import in the same worker. Reproduced with those two files, one worker and no retries (9 passed, 1 failed, 2 did not run); Sophie reproduced it independently and owns #20356. This candidate's hosted suite passed, which does not invalidate the order-dependent local failure. The CI change does not alter that fixture.

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here (`Missing script: agent-preflight`); declared change class `capability`. Hosted PR Baseline owns the corresponding gates.

### 🧠 Graph Ingestion Notes

*   **`[RETROSPECTIVE]`**: When consolidating multiple Playwright runs onto a single CI job in a repository whose unit suite spawns nested Playwright CLI child processes, overriding `PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_NAME` / `PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_FILE` in the parent environment leaks into child processes; removing and snapshotting the fixed config `outputFile` (`test/playwright/test-results/unit/test-results.json`) after each invocation (`[ -s "${report_path}" ] && node -e 'JSON.parse(...)'`) isolates each run's report cleanly while also catching killed/crashed test processes that exit before reporter teardown.
